title: Empirica run-scoped Docker spike qualification record /3
description: The closed shape of siffran.empirica.docker-spike-qualification-record/3 (Empirica 7.2 section 4.5), written durably and content-addressed under $EMPIRICA_SANDBOX_HOME/docker-spike-qualification-v3/records/ before the run's binding compare-and-set (write-first). This schema is the record shape's definition home; the runtime validator (adapters/sandbox/run_qualification.py:validate_run_record) remains the authoritative admission and is registered with the contract conformance harness only when E2c is accepted. Semantic checks this schema cannot express are listed in x-harness-semantic-checks and stay behaviour-tested in the owner: the exact content-addressed file name and qualification_record_digest equality, the execution_binding_digest recomputation, the run-generation lineage on load, the /2 namespace isolation, and the probe order/expected equality.

runtime.description: The observed Docker runtime facts of the pinned daemon, exactly the /2 runtime shape (docker_cli, endpoint, context, versions, platforms, security options, resource-limit capability flags, capacity, host facts, discovery_reads, optional daemon_id). The closed field set and the capability admission are the /2 authority contract's; they are not restated here.

semantic_authority.description: The canonical semantic projection of the runtime (endpoint, platform, required security, resource-limit capability flags, optional daemon_id); equal to the bound authority up to the documented daemon_id rule.

daemon_id.description: Docker info.ID when the observed daemon reports one; present exactly when the runtime carries it, and equal to it.

qualification_elapsed_ms.description: Measured with the injected qualification clock. The exclusive maximum is the 90 s default qualification budget, set from the operator timing session's measured evidence (spec section 5, Timing evidence: worst attempt 18.5 s); the owner constant DEFAULT_QUALIFICATION_SECONDS owns the binding code-side and re-measuring the timing session may move it.

x-harness-semantic-checks: qualification_record_digest is the canonical digest of the record body and names the record file (<digest-hex>.json)

execution_binding_digest is the canonical digest of the closed binding body (schema, run_binding, profile_id, authority_digest, policy_digest, implementation_digest, server_version, daemon_id, probe_image_id, qualification_image_digest, spike_images_digest, probe_digest, cleanup)
daemon_id is present exactly when runtime carries it and equals it
probes are exactly the five fixed probes in order with their fixed expected outcomes and no realization digest on unavailable probes
the last probe's running_network_membership equals the profile, earlier probes never hold it
run_binding identifiers are printable, separator-free and at most 128 UTF-8 bytes; generation and revision are 1..2^31-1
loading verifies the run-generation lineage (project, run, generation) and the exact content digest
/2 records, pointers and factories are never read or written; no pointer namespace exists in /3

spikeImages.description: The environment proposal's 1..16 approved local references, each sealed to its daemon image ID and canonical server-native platform with no declared volumes (Empirica 7.2 section 4.1).

realization_digest.description: The container's observed top-level Image realization digest on verdict probes; an unavailable probe admits no result, so it records none.
